tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2;
son of: Jehozadak (H3087);
father of: Joiakim (H3113); also called Jeshua at Ezr.2.2; 3.2,8; 4.3; 5.2; 1x12.1,7,10,26;
Aramaic of ye.ho.shu.a (יְהוֹשׁוּעַ "Joshua" H3091J)
§ Jeshua = "he is saved"
an exilic priest who returned with Zerubbabel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine}
